text:
Nina Park: Hey team — a couple onboarding questions that I couldn't find in the checklist. 1) I moved states recently and my W-4 has CA listed but I'm starting remote in OR. How do I set state tax withholding? 2) I got an invoice for relocation reimbursement but my first paycheck didn't include the reimbursement line. 3) If I enroll in transit commuter pre-tax, when does that deduction start?

Maya (People Ops): Welcome, @Nina! Short answers: 1) State withholding is set in Rippling under Payroll > Tax Withholding. Because OR has no state income tax, you'll want to update your state to OR and confirm county/local if applicable. We recommend uploading a proof of residency (lease/ID) if the address changed.

Jordan (Payroll): @Nina — We can set your state withholding to OR, but because your hire paperwork initially listed CA it may have already been used to calculate your first paycheck. If you change state before the payroll cutoff we'll apply it to the next pay run. Send me your new address and I'll confirm cutoff timing.

Nina Park: Thanks. My start date was 2026-05-12 and I updated address in Rippling today (2026-05-13). Is it too late for this cycle?

Jordan (Payroll): Probably too late for the paycheck that closed yesterday. If the payroll cutoff was before your address change, the CA withholding will apply to that paycheck. We'll make OR effective for the next cycle. DM me your payroll cutoff questions and I can check by employee ID.

Nina Park: Understood — will DM. About the relocation: I uploaded receipts and Finance bot replied ticket FIN-4421 approved, but I don't see the reimbursement line.

Payroll Bot: Ticket FIN-4421: Relocation reimbursement approved. Scheduled for next payroll run after processing. Status: queued.

Jordan (Payroll): We pay reimbursements on the next payroll run after Finance pushes the payment batch. If FIN approved late in the cycle it may have missed the batch and will be in the following run. I can confirm whether FIN included you in this cycle; uploading the FIN ticket helps.

Nina Park: FIN-4421 included details and amount. How will the reimbursement appear on the paystub?

Jordan (Payroll): It shows as a separate non-regular earnings line: "Relocation Reimbursement" and is taxable. You'll see withholding taxes applied per normal payroll rules. Net pay will reflect that.

Nina Park: Gotcha. Last: commuter pre-tax — I enrolled in the transit benefit during onboarding. Is there a waiting period or need to opt-in in payroll separately?

Tina (Benefits): If you elected transit during enrollment and it's within the enrollment window it should be active on your benefits effective date. Transit deductions start the payday following benefits effectiveness. For mid-month enrollments we align it to the next payroll cycle. If you need retroactive coverage (e.g., missed start), that's handled as a QLE; DM me and include your ticket and dates.

Nina Park: Thanks — I enrolled 2026-05-11. Also curious about COBRA: my previous employer had COBRA and I have some leftover claims in the system. Is there any coordination with Redwood benefits if I enroll here?

Maya (People Ops): COBRA from a previous employer is separate from Redwood benefits. You can enroll in Redwood plans immediately if within your hire/open enrollment window. COBRA claims or remaining balances are between you and your previous carrier. If you have overlapping coverage date questions (e.g., ongoing claim while switching plans) let us know and we'll provide carrier contacts.

Nina Park: One more thing — I saw an "eligibility pending" flag for medical; I uploaded my ID already. Anything else that blocks benefits becoming active?

Tina (Benefits): "Eligibility pending" usually means our Benefits team is verifying your onboarding batch or waiting for dependent docs (if you enrolled dependents). Since you enrolled only yourself and uploaded ID, it should clear within 1 business day. If it doesn't, reply with ticket number and we'll expedite.

Nina Park: Appreciate it. TL;DR: I'll DM payroll my address, keep an eye on FIN-4421 for the reimb, and ping Benefits if eligibility doesn't clear in 24h. Thanks! :smile:

Maya (People Ops): Welcome again, @Nina — ping any time and congrats on joining the team. :tada:
